summary: Backend-only testing of the bug fix in build_report: reports filtered by a concrete status now reflect CURRENT tag status (matching the 3D model / GET /api/tags), while status=all keeps the full movement history. 6/6 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1290 lines; consider splitting into routers (tags, teams, report, storage) for maintainability.

build_report uses last event with matching status for the current-status snapshot — correct, but if history is missing events (older tags backfilled with only one entry) the report skips them (continue on empty evs). Acceptable given backfill guarantees at startup.
In upsert_tag, when reverting from 'instalado' back to 'fabricado' the team_id from the previous instalado event stays in history (as intended for status=all movement log). Fine.
team='none' logic in build_report only makes sense for status in ('instalado','all'); for other statuses it silently returns empty — could 422 instead but not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test creates one TEST_TeamIter7 team and cycles a facade panel's status; all test-created data (tag + team) is removed in teardown. Verified: tags=0, teams collection contains only pre-existing 'Equipo 1' and 'Equipo 2'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix validated. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_report_current_state_iter7.py cleans up after itself (deletes created team + clears created tag). Pre-existing teams 'Equipo 1' and 'Equipo 2' were present before and after the run (not created by test).
rca of the issue: Previous build_report iterated over history events for status filters and included any event with matching status, so panels reverted to another state still appeared as 'instalado'. Fix: for status!='all', require t.status==status (current state) and use the LAST matching event's date for the row. status='all' preserves per-event iteration (movement log).
